description:
<!-- Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-25. -->
## YouTube

- **Seekbar (#71):** With custom seekbar colors in Dark theme, the portrait seekbar keeps a clean accent-colored end when controls fade. The thumb still appears when controls are shown. On YouTube 20.05.46, **Minimal** and **Tablet** miniplayers show the buffered segment again.
- **Home feed (#83):** **Show channel names on Home** stays active after searching, going back, and refreshing. This works in Classic and Default layouts. Search results keep their original bylines.
- **Downloads (#84):** Fixed long seeks in YouTube’s watch player for RVX-saved videos larger than 2 GiB. Both players support custom speeds such as `0.05×`, `1.50×`, and `2.75×` without changing audio pitch. In the built-in player, changing speed while paused keeps it paused. Swipe up to enter fullscreen or down to exit; assigned volume and brightness zones still work as before. YouTube Premium downloads are unchanged.

Verified on a signed-in Moto, including backward and forward seeks past 4 GiB in a one-hour, 6.8 GB 1440p VP9 file and playback from an app-owned MediaStore download. Patched YouTube 20.05.46, 21.13.164, 21.39.525, and 21.45.90 without forcing compatibility.

This is a development prerelease. In Morphe Manager, add or update the [RVX dev patch source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/rvx-dev/patches-bundle.json) separately from stable, select **v1.52.0-dev.1**, and repatch and reinstall YouTube. You can also import the `.mpp` below via **Sources → + → Local**.
